name: File Tools
description: File utilities: file info (size/dates/attributes) and file/folder hash (MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256).

slashCommands.title: File Info
slashCommands.description: Show file size, creation/modification/access times, and attributes for an explicit path or selected files.

slashCommands.title: File Hash
slashCommands.description: Compute MD5, SHA-1, or SHA-256 hash for explicit paths or selected files/folders.
